pages.name: Slav: Dutch, 8...Nbd7 9.Qe2 Bg6 10.e4
pages.notes: 10.e4 overview did not explain the gambit (10...Bxc3 11.bxc3 Nxe4 12.Ba3); plan 1 gave an impossible f4-f5 push; plan 2 claimed an isolated d-pawn for White. Rewrote overview and both plans.

pages.name: Slav: Dutch, 8...O-O 9.Nh4
pages.notes: Plan 1 claimed an open g-file and f2-f4; plan 3 said Qe2 connects the rooks with the c1-bishop at home. Rewrote overview (not sharp; Nxf5 threat, ...Bg4/...Bg6 or ...exf5) and all plans; British spelling.

pages.name: Slav: Dutch, 8...O-O 9.Nh4 Bg6
pages.notes: Overview and plan 1 said Nxg6 gives doubled h-pawns (they are g-pawns) and an open h-file (half-open); plan 4 gave Black the bishop pair after bxc3. Rewrote all; British spelling.

pages.name: Slav: Dutch, 8...O-O 9.Nh4 Nbd7
pages.notes: Plan 2 named a d5-pawn Black does not have and an ...e6-e5 break after the e-pawn has gone to f5. Rewrote overview and both plans; British spelling.

pages.name: Slav: Dutch, 8...O-O 9.Nh4 Nbd7 10.Nxf5 exf5
pages.notes: Overview claimed an open g-file and an f4 outpost; plans named an e6-pawn and a light-squared bishop Black no longer has, ...Ba6, and the g-file. Rewrote all.

pages.name: Slav: Dutch, 8...O-O 9.Nh4 Nbd7 10.Nxf5 exf5 11.Qc2
pages.notes: Plan 1 said Qc2 pressures g7 (it hits f5); plan 2 called the e-file open. Fixed both; British spelling in overview.

pages.name: Slav: Dutch, 8...O-O 9.Qe2 Bg6
pages.notes: Overview said 9...Bg6 unpins the f6-knight (no pin exists); plan 2 routed ...Nbd7-e4, which a knight cannot do. Rewrote overview and plans 2 and 3.

pages.name: Slav: Dutch, 8...O-O 9.Qe2 Bg6 10.Rd1 Nbd7
pages.notes: Plan 2 gave ...Nb6 as controlling e4 and an impossible ...a5-a4 with White's pawn on a4. Rewrote plan 2; British spelling elsewhere.

pages.name: Slav: Dutch, 8...O-O 9.Qe2 Nbd7
pages.notes: Plan 2 met e4 with ...dxe4, but Black has no d-pawn. Rewrote plan 2; British spelling in overview and plan 4.

pages.name: Slav: Dutch, 8...O-O 9.Qe2 Nbd7 10.e4 Bg6 11.Bd3
pages.notes: Plan 1 gave an impossible f4-f5 (knight on f3); plans 3 and 4 were vague. Rewrote plans 1, 3 and 4 (e5 Nd5, ...Bh5 pin, guarding d4); British spelling.
